ios.desc:
The Wiki Game is a Wikipedia race: get from one article to another by clicking links only. Now in 10 languages - play in English, Hebrew, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Arabic or Japanese, with the whole app translated and a Wikipedia in your language.

HOW IT WORKS
You get two Wikipedia articles: a start and a target. Reach the target by clicking only the blue links inside each page. Fewer clicks, more points. Every round is a small speedrun down the rabbit hole of human knowledge.

GAME MODES
- Daily Challenge: one new race every day, the same for every player in your language. Build a daily streak, protect it with freezes and earn keys.
- Journey: more than 2,000 levels, from one-click warm-ups to expert routes through articles you have never heard of.
- Practice: random races, or pick your own topics and articles.
- Challenge friends: send a race and see who gets there in fewer clicks.

MORE TO LOVE
- Keys reveal the best path and guide you step by step when you are stuck.
- Collect every target article you reach and build your own Wikipedia collection.
- Learn something new every race: history, science, geography, sports, pop culture.
- A brain game for trivia and quiz fans that goes beyond multiple choice. Great for students and families.

PLAY IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Each language has its own Wikipedia, its own daily challenge and its own levels. Switch languages any time in Settings.

PLAY IN THE BROWSER
No phone at hand? Play the full game for free at thewikigame.yfranko.com.

Wiki race, wikiracing, the Wikipedia game or a Wikipedia speedrun: whatever you call it, "just one more race!"

Questions or ideas? Email us any time.

NOTE: The Wiki Game uses content from Wikipedia, available under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 license (CC BY-SA 4.0). This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Wikimedia Foundation.

Privacy policy: https://thewikigame.yfranko.com/privacy

quotes.text:
When I was younger I used to play it with the original Wikipedia website. Now I have created a game based on that that have levels and multiplayer mode.

Available for both Android and iOS, hope you will enjoy playing it!

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hadadfranco.wikygame&hl=en

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-wiki-game-wikipedia-game/id6755500017
